summary: @or-sdk/contacts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` either invokes a system `bun` binary or downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip`, extracts and chmods it executable, and then invokes it against `math_init.js`, a tarball-shipped 727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (obfuscator.io-style string-array with hex-mangled identifiers, `with` blocks defeating strict-mode parsers, control-flow flattening; banner `// @bun @bun-cjs`). `math_init.js` is neither declared nor explained in README or `package.json`. A contacts REST SDK has no legitimate need to pull an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute a bundled obfuscated multi-hundred-KB blob under it. The alternate runtime is used specifically to execute a bundled, purpose-mismatched obfuscated payload, bypassing Node-based install-time scanners — the canonical alternate-runtime-dropper shape, yielding arbitrary code execution on any host that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
